new_axis_hypothesis: Original peak credit requires qualified flight; bounded prelaunch root-upward kinetic progress may provide a preceding learning signal. This is not a unique physical-cause proof or success guarantee.

primary_literature.title: Curriculum-Based Reinforcement Learning for Quadrupedal Jumping: A Reference-free Design
primary_literature.relevance: Describes sparse jump rewards and staged learning. Their random-state initialization and hardware settings are not adopted here; source evidence only motivates examining the preceding reward signal.

primary_literature.title: Towards Quadrupedal Jumping and Walking for Dynamic Locomotion using Reinforcement Learning
primary_literature.relevance: Uses phase-related shaping including a flight apex estimate. Our supported root-velocity proxy is an independent bounded heuristic, not their recipe or a validated MOD4 energy measurement.

primary_literature.title: Robust Quadruped Jumping via Deep Reinforcement Learning
primary_literature.relevance: Considers actuation constraints. Original MOD4 torque, energy and hardware guards remain unchanged; no paper-specific motor assumptions are transferred.
